description:
The building where Euphoria lives. Four Lone Star officers respond to the PANICBUTTON within five minutes; the alarm can be cancelled inside five minutes with a memorised code.

The desk guard keeps a loaded Enfield AS7 shotgun behind the desk. The courier on duty will not fight — average human, all 3s.

Elevators are thumbprint-locked and auto-select the resident's floor; bypassing needs an Electronics (5) Test, base time five minutes.

Rooms: Front entrance and guard station (four sets of double doors, computer terminal, PANICBUTTON alarm, camera, visitor-verification speaker), bar, private meeting room, lecture room doubling as a small theatre, store, garden courtyard, storeroom, men's and women's restrooms with sauna and shower, pool. Three elevators.

Layout derived from the printed floorplan on Queen Euphoria p.14. Measured 27 × 20 m by grid period (31 px, both axes) — the map carries a "□ = 1 metre" legend, so the scale is the book's, not an estimate.
